Package com.radiantlogic.iddm.ldap

package com.radiantlogic.iddm.ldap
LDAP-specific classes and interfaces for IDDM SDK operations.

This package contains LDAP request and response classes, distinguished name (DN) handling, and result codes that implement RFC 4511 LDAP protocol operations for the IDDM framework.
